title: 333章 滩涂起良田，辽疆隐患现
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林驰与苏松地方众士绅敲定垦荒盟约之后，借着龙游商帮傅宗伟率先附和牵头的势头，当即着手安置自莱州湾一路南迁而来的一万余山东饥民。

他全面推行以工代赈之策，尽数由这批流民出力，开垦苏松沿岸大片无人问津的滩涂与沙地。此地常年受海水浸渍，土质盐碱厚重，历来皆是废弃荒壤，难以耕作。众人引水引流，日复一日冲刷田地、洗盐润土，赶在秋令到来之前抢时劳作，只为如期播下冬小麦。

依徐光启多年深耕农本的精准推算，这万余劳力合力劳作，完全能在秋种之前，整治出三万余亩合格良田。

只是眼下时节紧迫，时日仓促，来不及规划错落耕种，今年这三万余亩新垦荒田，只能全数统一播种冬小麦。

按照此前双方议定的长久规制，日后田地地力稳固、耕作步入正轨，便将田亩对半划分。一半专种粮食，收成尽数供给奋武军所用；另一半种植棉花、桑麻等经济作物，产出全数归于挂靠田地的士绅商贾，林驰与军中绝不沾染分毫。

可眼下特殊，今年全数栽种粮食，士绅这边便拿不到半点经济作物的收益，空占田亩名分，却无利可图。

林驰心思周全，深知其中关节，不愿让江南士绅白白吃亏、寒了人心。便主动定下规制，以市面粮价八成的价钱，将今年新田所产全部冬小麦统一收购。

如此一来，既弥补了士绅今年无经济作物收成的空缺，稳住彼此合作根基，一众苏松士绅感念其体恤周全，皆交口称颂镇海伯胸襟气度、待人仁厚。

而北方源源不断涌入苏松地界的零散流民，林驰也做了妥善调度。从中拣选精壮青壮，交由水师船队分批运往东番岛安置。

一来疏解苏松本地人口压力，避免流民聚集滋生祸乱，保江南腹地安稳；二来持续为东番输送劳力，支撑海岛拓荒建设。

自奋武军奉旨入闽、经略东南海疆以来，不过短短数年光阴。这些年每逢闽地、山东遭遇荒乱，流离百姓无处安身，林驰便不断迁徙流民向东番安置。数年经营之下，东番岛上已集聚十数万百姓。

以打狗港为核心海港，沿岸堡垒、聚落接连落成，垦荒脚步不断向岛内纵深推进。数年倾力开垦治理，已然辟出百万亩沃土良田。

赵士桢常年坐镇东番总管兵仗局，数年打磨工艺、改良制法，如今岛上军械工坊体系完备，铳炮锻造、甲仗打造皆可自给自足，所造火器军械源源不断输送内陆，稳稳反哺奋武军全域武备。

世人向来称道“湖广熟，天下足”，可林驰眼界不拘一隅，早已布下长远大局。

徐光启常年观天察物、考究地气，早已提前警示，往后天时异变无常，旱涝交替不休，蝗灾荒乱必会频频频发。是以林驰苦心经营东番万顷良田，广积粮储，一为稳固奋武军全军粮草根基，不受朝廷粮饷掣肘；二为蓄下海量后备仓廪，待来日大荒降临、生民流离之际，有粮可济万民、安抚四方，于乱世之中守住一线生机。

苏松大地大兴垦荒、蓄力固本之时，远在东番常年督造军械的赵士桢，终是启程返回崇明卫。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After Lin Chi finalized the land reclamation agreement with the local gentry in Susong, and with the momentum of Longyou merchant gang Fu Zongwei taking the lead, he immediately began to resettle the more than 10,000 hungry Shandong people who had migrated south from Laizhou Bay.

He fully implemented the work-for-relief policy and used all the efforts of these refugees to reclaim large tracts of untouched tidal flats and sandy land along the Susong coast.This area has been soaked by seawater all year round, and the soil is heavily saline and alkaline. It has always been abandoned wasteland, making it difficult to cultivate.People diverted water and diverted water, washed the fields, washed salt and moistened the soil day after day, rushing to work before the arrival of autumn, just to sow winter wheat as scheduled.

According to Xu Guangqi's accurate calculations, which he has been deeply involved in farming for many years, these more than 10,000 laborers working together can fully cultivate more than 30,000 acres of qualified fertile land before autumn planting.

However, the current season is tight and time is short, so there is no time to plan scattered farming. This year, the more than 30,000 acres of newly reclaimed land can only be sown with winter wheat.

According to the long-term regulations previously agreed upon by both parties, in the future, when the soil fertility of the fields is stable and farming is on track, the acres will be divided in half.Half of the crops were dedicated to growing grain, and all the harvests were used by the Fenwu Army; the other half were planted with cash crops such as cotton, mulberry and hemp, and all the output went to the gentry and merchants who were affiliated with the fields. Lin Chi had no involvement with the army.

But the current situation is special. This year, all grains are planted, and the gentry will not get any income from cash crops. The acres of land are occupied, but there is no profit.

Lin Chi was thoughtful and well aware of the joints, and did not want the Jiangnan gentry to suffer in vain and chill the hearts of the people.He took the initiative to set regulations to purchase all the winter wheat produced in Xintian this year at 80% of the market price.

In this way, it not only made up for the gentry's lack of cash crop harvest this year, but also stabilized the foundation of mutual cooperation. All the Susong gentry were grateful for his thoughtfulness and praised Zhen Haibo for his magnanimity and kindness.

Lin Chi also made proper arrangements for the scattered refugees who continued to pour into Susong's territory from the north.The best young men were selected from them and sent to the navy fleet to be transported to Dongfan Island in batches for resettlement.

Firstly, it relieves the local population pressure in Susong, prevents refugees from gathering and causing chaos, and ensures stability in the hinterland of Jiangnan; secondly, it continues to provide labor to Dongfan and supports the development and construction of the island.

It has only been a few years since the Fenwu Army entered Fujian and explored the southeastern seaboard.In recent years, whenever Fujian and Shandong suffered from devastation and the displaced people had no place to stay, Lin Chi continued to move the refugees eastward for resettlement.After several years of operation, tens of thousands of people have gathered on Dongfan Island.

With Dagou Port as the core seaport, coastal fortresses and settlements were built one after another, and the pace of reclamation continued to advance deeper into the island.After several years of hard work in reclamation and management, millions of acres of fertile land have been created.

Zhao Shizhen has been in charge of the Military and Warfare Bureau of Dongfan all year round, and has spent several years polishing craftsmanship and improving manufacturing methods. Now the island has a complete ordnance workshop system. It can be self-sufficient in the forging of muskets and cannons and the production of armor. The firearms and ordnance manufactured are continuously transported to the inland, steadily feeding back the entire territory of the Fenwu Army.

The world has always praised that "Huguang is well versed in the world," but Lin Chi's vision is not limited to one corner, and he has already laid out the long-term overall situation.

Xu Guangqi has been observing the sky and observing the earth's atmosphere all year round. He has already warned in advance that the weather will be unpredictable in the future, with droughts and floods alternating endlessly, and locust plagues and famines will occur frequently.Therefore, Lin Chi painstakingly managed thousands of hectares of fertile land in the east and accumulated extensive grain reserves, firstly to stabilize the food foundation of the entire Fenwu Army and not be restricted by the court's food and salary; secondly, to store a large number of reserve warehouses. When the famine comes and the people are displaced, there will be food to help the people, appease the four directions, and maintain a glimmer of hope in troubled times.

When the land of Susong was vigorously reclaiming wasteland and accumulating strength to consolidate its foundation, Zhao Shizhen, who had been supervising the construction of ordnance all year round in Dongpan, finally set off to return to Chongming Guard.
